title: Smithery MCP Server
description: Schema for the MCP server resource in the Smithery Platform API. A server is identified by its qualifiedName (namespace/server) and exposes one or more tools via the Model Context Protocol. Returned by GET /servers and GET /servers/{qualifiedName}.

qualifiedName.description: Fully qualified server name in the form `namespace/server`.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the server.

description.description: Short description of what the server does.

homepage.description: Optional homepage URL for the server.

iconUrl.description: URL of the server icon (uploaded via PUT /servers/{qualifiedName}/icon, max 1 MB).

namespace.description: The namespace under which the server is published.

owner.description: The user or organization that owns the namespace.

transport.description: The MCP transport this server uses. Smithery hosts Streamable HTTP servers and distributes stdio servers via MCPB bundles.

hosted.description: Whether the server is hosted on Smithery infrastructure (true) or registered as an external server (false).

deployment.description: Latest deployment metadata for the server.

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint for the server.

bundleUrl.description: URL to the MCPB bundle for stdio servers (download via GET /servers/{qualifiedName}/download).

domains.description: Custom domains associated with this server.

triggers.description: Trigger types exposed by the server.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input arguments.

outputSchema.description: Optional Zod-inferable JSON Schema for the tool's output.
